newsitem.title: USA: USA Detergents to defend against lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: USA Detergents to defend against lawsuit.

text.p: USA Detergents Inc said Wednesday it planned to "vigorously" defend itself against a shareholder lawsuit filed against it for alleged failure to disclose information about its operations.
The company, which makes laundry and household cleaning products, said it was reviewing the suit with legal counsel.

On May 7, shareholders filed a suit against USA Detergents for allegedly failing to disclose on a timely basis adverse information about its business and financial condition. The lawsuit does not specify the amount of monetary damages being sought.

On May 8, the company said it had violated its financial covenants under its bank lending agreements due to its first quarter results. It said it was seeking to waive the violations and get additional credit facilities.
It reported a loss of $0.30 per share for the quarter against a profit of $0.16 a year ago, blaming manufacturing and distribution inefficiencies.
